title: RC API to Canonical OpenAPI Mapping Gate
mappingRule: Every public RC operation MUST have an exact method+path+operationId entry in Canonical OpenAPI. Server base /api/v1 is transport metadata and MUST NOT be duplicated in RC paths.

requiredEvidence.requirement: Every RC operation has an exact operationId match in Canonical OpenAPI.
Every RC operation has an exact HTTP method and path match in Canonical OpenAPI.
Authentication requirements and public/private semantics are aligned with Canonical OpenAPI.
Success status and required concurrency/idempotency parameters are represented in Canonical OpenAPI.
No RC public operation exists outside Canonical OpenAPI without an explicit internal/private designation.
